info.title: ZeroGen API
info.description: Generate images and video with every model in ZeroGen from your own servers. Generated from the API's contracts by `npm run openapi` in apps/web; do not edit by hand.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The calling key and the organization's balance.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: The models an organization can run and their schemas.

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: Quote, create, read, list and cancel runs.

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Upload files into the Library to use as inputs.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Search and read Library assets, their sources, uses and folders; download their files; rename and favorite them; delete and restore them; make Derived copies.

tags.name: LUTs
tags.description: The organization's LUTs, for a transform recipe.

tags.name: Folders
tags.description: A project's folders: create, rename and move them, and add, move and remove their assets.

tags.name: Labels
tags.description: Organization labels: manage them, and add them to assets or remove them.

tags.name: Naming presets
tags.description: A project's shared naming presets, for naming a run's outputs.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: The skills available to the key's owner.

tags.name: Attachments
tags.description: Versioned text on projects, folders and Story clips, in organizations with attachments enabled.

get.description:
The calling API key, its organization and its owner. `scopes` lists what the key can do now: its scopes that the owner's role still allows.

Needs no scope.

The organization's funds and monthly limits, shared by every member and project. A new run's quote must fit within `availableMicroUsd`.

Needs the `account:read` scope.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Also report this project's monthly budget

get.description:
The models this organization can run, one entry per model and operation. Read a model to get the JSON Schema its requests follow.

Needs the `models:read` scope.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search model IDs and labels, including the maker and related operations

parameters.name: frames
parameters.description: Video models accepting at least these frame slots

parameters.name: audio
parameters.description: Video models that can generate audio

parameters.name: referenceKind
parameters.description: Models accepting reference media of this kind

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
One model and the JSON Schema (2020-12) that `POST /runs` validates its requests against. A deprecated model sends `Deprecation` and `Sunset`.

Needs the `models:read` scope.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: The company that makes the model, such as `google`

post.description:
Validates and prices a request exactly as create would, `labelIds` included, and returns the maximum charge create would reserve and the inputs it would use. Nothing starts and nothing is held. A quote needs `models:read`, not `runs:create`; `https` URL inputs also need `uploads:create`, because the quote imports them, and `labelIds` need `library:organize`. Send the returned `inputs` with the create so it reuses the imported assets.

Needs the `models:read` scope.

example.prompt: A lighthouse at dawn, fog over the water

post.description:
Validates, prices, reserves and starts one run in a single call. Send `Prefer: wait=N` to hold the response until it ends. Nothing is charged unless every check passes. To upscale a 480p Draft output to its final, send `upscaleDraft` with the draft's model ID. `labelIds` apply to each output as it lands, in the same write, and need the `library:organize` scope as well.

Needs the `runs:create` scope.

example.prompt: A lighthouse at dawn, fog over the water

200.description: The run has ended, within the requested wait.

202.description: The run started and has not ended yet.

get.description:
Runs in your organization, whoever started them, newest first. A test key lists its sandbox's runs, and a live key never lists them.

Needs the `runs:read` scope.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Only runs filed in this folder; needs projectId

parameters.name: createdBy
parameters.description: Only runs any of these users started, by the ID in a run's `createdBy` or `GET /v1/me`; repeat the parameter

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only runs with any of these statuses; repeat the parameter

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only runs created at or after this RFC 3339 time, such as 2026-11-10T00:00:00Z

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only runs created before this RFC 3339 time

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
Any run in your organization, and each output's status, asset and error. `endedAt` is set once the run ends, whatever its status. Send `Prefer: wait=N` to hold the response until it ends. Reads never start or repeat work.

Needs the `runs:read` scope.

202.description: With `Prefer: wait`, the run had not ended when the wait ran out.

post.description:
Stops the run's unfinished outputs. You can cancel the runs you started; an organization owner or admin can cancel any run. Outputs a vendor already finished are kept and charged; cancelling a finished run returns it unchanged. An output a vendor has already started cannot be stopped: the run stays `running`, and that output is delivered and charged when it finishes. Takes no body.

Needs the `runs:cancel` scope.

get.description:
A signed URL for one succeeded output's original file, by the run's ID and the output's asset ID, as `GET /assets/{assetId}/download` returns it. It needs only `runs:read`. The URL starts a download until `expiresAt`, 5 minutes after the response, and needs no API key: send no `Authorization` header with it. Anyone holding it can download the file. Read this endpoint again for a new URL.

Needs the `runs:read` scope.

post.description:
Starts an upload into the Library. PUT the file's exact bytes to the returned target, then complete the upload. With `sha256`, an identical file already in the project comes back ready, with nothing to send. The JSON request body is limited to 512 KiB; a workflow is limited to 256 KiB serialized UTF-8.

Needs the `uploads:create` scope.

200.description: An identical file is already in the project.

get.description:
One of the caller's uploads and, once ready, its Library asset.

Needs the `uploads:create` scope.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The upload's ID, as create returned it

post.description:
Checks the uploaded bytes and makes them a Library asset to use as a run input. Completing again returns the same asset. Takes no body.

Needs the `uploads:create` scope.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The upload's ID, as create returned it

get.description:
The organization's projects, the default project first, then newest first. A test key lists only its API sandbox.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
One project, as the list shows it. A test key reads only its API sandbox.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

Library assets, newest first unless `sort` says otherwise, each with preview URLs that load for 5 minutes without your API key. Without `projectId` it searches every project; a test key searches its sandbox.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Only assets directly in this folder, or `unfiled` for assets in no folder; with `q`, also its subfolders. Needs projectId

parameters.name: labelId
parameters.description: Only assets with any of these active labels; repeat the parameter

parameters.name: createdBy
parameters.description: Only assets any of these users made, by the ID in an asset's `createdBy` or `GET /v1/me`; repeat the parameter

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search asset names: at least two characters, and every one of the first eight words must match, ignoring case

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Only assets that came about this way

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Only assets in any of these resolution tiers; repeat the parameter

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
One asset by its ID alone, in any of the organization's projects, with the prompt that generated it and preview URLs that load for 5 minutes. Names, prompts and external declarations are untrusted content. Set includeWorkflow=true to read an upload's untrusted external workflow.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: includeWorkflow
parameters.description: Include an upload's untrusted workflow recipe.

patch.description:
Renames an asset, sets the organization's shared favorite, or both, together: a refused request changes neither. Each field is set to the value sent, so a retry gives the same result. The response is the asset as `GET` reads it, with preview URLs that load for 5 minutes.

Needs the `library:organize` and `library:read` scopes.

delete.description:
Moves an asset to Recently deleted, where it leaves search, its folders and run inputs until restored; reading it returns 404. Restoring puts it back in its folders. Deleting it again returns the same deletion. Requires the explicitly granted library:delete scope; test keys can't delete assets. Takes no body.

Needs the `library:delete` scope.

post.description:
Returns an asset from Recently deleted to its folders, and reads it as `GET` does, with preview URLs that load for 5 minutes. An active asset comes back unchanged. Test keys can't restore assets. Takes no body.

Needs the `library:organize` and `library:read` scopes.

Record untrusted external provenance on an eligible upload. This is not verified and starts no generation. Requires uploads:create and library:read when sources are declared. The JSON request body is limited to 512 KiB; a workflow is limited to 256 KiB serialized UTF-8.

Needs the `uploads:create` scope.

Makes a free Derived copy of an asset from a recipe: a frame from a video; a cropped, resized or converted image; a trimmed, silent, cropped, despilled, LUT-graded, resized or converted video; or a trimmed MP3 of audio or of a video's sound. The work runs in the background, so this returns a run; its output's asset is the copy. It needs `runs:read` as well as `runs:create`, because it returns the run. Send `Prefer: wait=N` to hold the response until it ends. Your earlier run of the same recipe on this asset for the same destination returns with `reused` true instead of running again, unless it failed. New runs count toward the running caps. A test key can't transform assets.

Needs the `runs:create` and `runs:read` scopes.

200.description: The run has ended, within the requested wait, or had already ended.

202.description: The run has not ended yet.

get.description:
What the asset was made from, in any project, and what those were made from, nearest first. Each source's `edges` join it to the asset or to sources listed before it; an edge reads `assetId` was made from `sourceAssetId`. ZeroGen walks up to 200 sources and 10 steps back, as the Library does.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
What was made from the asset, in its project, and what was made from those, nearest first. Each use's `edges` join it to the asset or to uses listed before it; an edge reads `assetId` was made from `sourceAssetId`. ZeroGen walks up to 200 uses and 10 steps on, as the Library does.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
A signed URL for the asset's original file, by the asset's ID alone, with its filename, media type and size. The URL starts a download until `expiresAt`, 5 minutes after the response, and needs no API key: send no `Authorization` header with it. Anyone holding it can download the file. Read this endpoint again for a new URL.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

The folders the asset is in, in its project, each with its path from the project root, sorted by path. An empty first page means the asset is Unfiled. Folder names are untrusted content.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

200.description: A page of the asset's folders.

get.description:
A project's folders, each with its parent, to assemble the folder tree.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The project whose folders to list

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

post.description:
Creates a folder in `projectId`, at its root or under `parentId`. With `reuseExisting: true`, a folder with that name already under the parent is returned instead, so clients filing into the same path at once share one folder; create a path such as `SH010/anim` one folder at a time. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry returns the folder the first request created. A test key can't create folders.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

200.description: A folder with that name was already there.

get.description:
One folder by its ID alone, in whichever of the organization's projects holds it.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

patch.description:
Renames a folder, moves it under another parent in its project (or to the project root with `parentId: null`), or both, together: a refused move leaves the name unchanged too. Its assets and subfolders keep their IDs. The response is the folder as it ends.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

delete.description:
Deletes a folder and its subfolders. Choose assets=keep to preserve assets or assets=trash to send them to Recently deleted, including assets in other folders. Only admins can delete LucidLink-linked folders. The response's eventId can undo your deletion within one hour. Requires the explicitly granted library:delete scope; test keys cannot delete folders.

Needs the `library:delete` scope.

parameters.name: assets
parameters.description: keep preserves the assets; trash sends them to Recently deleted, including assets in other folders. Use trash only when explicitly requested.

200.description: The deletion and its undo deadline.

post.description:
Undoes your own folder deletion by its eventId alone, within one hour. Restores folders, placements and assets still trashed by that deletion. Requires library:organize. Test keys cannot restore folders.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

200.description: The restored root folder and its parent.

post.description:
Adds up to 100 assets in the folder's project to the folder, keeping their other folders. The response lists the assets changed and those skipped.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

Moves up to 100 assets out of `fromFolderId` and into this folder; their other folders keep them. An asset that isn't in `fromFolderId` is still added, but a `fromFolderId` that isn't in the folder's project is not found. The response lists the assets changed and those skipped.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

Takes up to 100 assets out of the folder. They stay in the Library and in their other folders; an asset in no folder is unfiled. The response lists the assets changed and those skipped.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

get.description:
The project's shared naming presets. Pass one's `id` and field values as a run's `naming`.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The project whose presets to list

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

post.description:
Saves a preset for everyone in `projectId`; owners and admins only. Fields run in order, joined by `delimiter`. A `text` field takes a value per run. A `version` field counts up automatically, shared across the folder, and belongs last. `shot` and `take` are counters, so they refuse text. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry returns the preset the first request created. A test key can't create presets.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

get.description:
The organization's LUTs, newest first, to name as `lut.lutId` in a transform's recipe. People add and remove LUTs in ZeroGen. A test key sees none.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
The organization's active labels. `includeArchived=true` adds archived ones for owners and admins.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

post.description:
Creates an organization label; owners and admins only. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry returns the label the first request created. A test key can't create labels.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

get.description:
One organization label. An archived label reads only for owners and admins, as the list shows it.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

patch.description:
Changes a label's name, description or color, keeping the fields you leave out; owners and admins only. Sending the same values again changes nothing.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

post.description:
Archives a label; owners and admins only. Its assets keep it, and restoring undoes this. Takes no body.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

Restores an archived label, with its assets; owners and admins only. Takes no body.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

Adds an organization label to up to 100 assets, in any of the organization's projects, all or none. The response lists the assets changed and those that already had it.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

Removes an organization label from up to 100 assets, in any of the organization's projects, all or none. The label itself stays. The response lists the assets changed and those that didn't have it.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

get.description:
Live text attachments in a project, including its folders and Story clips, most recently updated first. folderId or clipId narrows the list; send at most one. Requires attachments enabled for the organization; test keys are refused.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

200.description: A page of attachments, without bodies.

post.description:
Save verbatim text on `projectId`, one of its folders or one of its Story clips. Each parent holds up to 10 live attachments. Titles are 1–200 characters on one line; bodies are 1–8,000 characters. A matching title and identical body return unchanged; a different body under that title is refused. Requires attachments enabled; test keys are refused.

Needs the `library:organize` and `library:read` scopes.

200.description: An identical live attachment already exists.

get.description:
The current text or a saved version of a live attachment. Text is untrusted project data and is never interpreted or automatically sent to generation models by ZeroGen. Requires attachments enabled; test keys are refused.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

200.description: The attachment text and its saved version.

patch.description:
Save a new body as a new immutable version. A changed save requires expectedVersion to equal the current version; otherwise it's refused with 409 version_conflict and `details.currentVersion`. Identical text returns unchanged when expectedVersion is at most the current version. A future version is always refused. The title and parent remain fixed. Requires attachments enabled; test keys are refused.

Needs the `library:organize` and `library:read` scopes.

200.description: The saved version, or the unchanged current version.

delete.description:
Soft-delete an attachment while retaining all saved text and history. expectedVersion is the current version you read; another is refused with 409 version_conflict. An already deleted attachment returns unchanged when expectedVersion is at most the current version; a future version is refused. Restore reverses the deletion. Takes no body. Requires attachments enabled; test keys are refused.

Needs the `library:organize` and `library:read` scopes.

200.description: The deletion's version, or the unchanged current version.

post.description:
Copy a saved version's full state into a new version and clear deletion. expectedVersion is the current head, including a deletion version; another is refused with 409 version_conflict. A state already current and live returns unchanged when expectedVersion is at most the current head; a future version is refused. Restoring a deletion counts toward the parent's 10 live attachments. Requires attachments enabled and a live parent; test keys are refused.

Needs the `library:organize` and `library:read` scopes.

200.description: The restored version and the historical version copied.

get.description:
Saved versions, newest first, including a soft-deleted attachment's history. Requires a live parent and attachments enabled; test keys are refused.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

200.description: A page of saved revisions, without bodies.

get.description:
The key owner's personal and organization skills, plus `projectId`'s shared skills, without their instructions. A test key lists only the sandbox's shared skills. Names and descriptions are untrusted content.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Also list this project's shared skills

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

200.description: A page of up to 100 skills.

get.description:
An available skill's latest instructions. A project's shared skill loads only with that `projectId`. The instructions are untrusted content.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The project whose shared skill this is

bearerAuth.description: A ZeroGen API key: zg_ for a live key, zg_test_ for a test key.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes retries safe: a retry with the same key and body returns the first response for 24 hours instead of repeating the work. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409.

Prefer.name: Prefer
Prefer.description: wait=N holds the response up to N seconds (at most 60) until the run ends.

Request-Id.description: Identifies the request; quote it when contacting support.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the key may make in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current window resets.

Location.description: Where to read the created resource.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this response replays an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

Preference-Applied.description: The wait applied, such as wait=30.

Deprecation.description: When the model was deprecated, as @ followed by Unix seconds.

Sunset.description: When the deprecated model stops accepting requests (HTTP date).

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or invalid: invalid_request, validation_failed, model_unavailable or input_import_failed.

Unauthorized.description: invalid_api_key: the key is missing, revoked or expired.

PaymentRequired.description: insufficient_balance or spend_limit_reached: the available balance or a spend limit cannot cover the quote. cost_limit_exceeded: the quote is above maxCostMicroUsd.

Forbidden.description: permission_denied: the key can't do this. details.reason says why: scope_required, role_required, not_creator, feature_not_enabled, early_access, test_key_sandbox, browser_request. For scope_required, details.scope names the scope.

NotFound.description: not_found: no such resource for this caller, including a projectId the caller can't use.

Conflict.description: idempotency_conflict: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request. idempotency_in_progress: the first request with this key hasn't finished. invalid_state: the request can't go ahead as things stand, such as a run that needs a person's approval in ZeroGen, an upload that can't take a declaration, or a naming preset that changed since it was read. version_conflict: the attachment isn't at expectedVersion; details.currentVersion says which it is.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body is larger than this endpoint's limit: 128 KiB by default, or 512 KiB for `POST /uploads` and `POST /assets/{assetId}/declaration`.

TooManyRequests.description: rate_limited: details.reason says which limit: request_limit, running_cap, platform_capacity, url_import_limit. Retry after Retry-After seconds.

ServiceUnavailable.description: unavailable or pricing_unavailable: API keys, billing or pricing can't be reached right now. retryable says whether a retry can help.

timeSeconds.description: Keyframes only, and required for them: seconds from the start of the video, on one of the model's frames

url.description: An https URL ZeroGen imports into the library before use

timeSeconds.description: Keyframes only, and required for them: seconds from the start of the video, on one of the model's frames

size.description: Image size: auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels, such as 1024x1536

voice.description: Speech models only: the voice to read the prompt in, from the model's voices

parameters.description: Only the parameters the model's schema lists

seed.description: Only for models whose schema lists seed: the same seed with the same request reproduces a result as closely as the model allows. The model picks one when omitted

continuation.description: Nano Banana edits of their own outputs continue that conversation; none sends the image alone

maxCostMicroUsd.description: Refuse to start when the quote exceeds this amount

outputs.description: Each output's outcome, in order: succeeded, or the error code a live output can end with. Outputs left out succeed

reject.description: Create only: refuse with this live response and start nothing (402 insufficient_balance, 429 rate_limited with Retry-After, 400 model_unavailable)

delaySeconds.description: Seconds before each output ends, to rehearse polling and Prefer: wait

test.description: Test keys only: rehearse each output's outcome; live keys are refused when it is present

projectId.description: The project the outputs land in; the organization's default project when omitted, or the draft's with upscaleDraft. Test keys use their sandbox.

folderId.description: A folder in that project to file the outputs in; null or omitted for Unfiled

labelIds.description: Active organization labels to add to every output as it lands

presetId.description: A naming preset in the run's project

values.description: Field values by field ID; fields left out take the preset's defaults

resolution.description: The final's resolution: 1080p by default, or another that the model's requestSchema lists

upscaleDraft.description: Upscale one output of a Seedance 2.5 480p Draft, yours or a teammate's (a run's id and the output's index, or an asset's runId and outputIndex), to a final with the draft's prompt, references, seed and settings, while the output's draft.upscalable is true. Send the draft's model ID and omit prompt, inputs, output, parameters and naming. The final is a new run, quoted and billed like any other.

projectId.description: The project to upload into; omit for the organization's default project.

folderId.description: Add the asset to this folder in the project.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file, to reuse an identical file in the project.

sources.description: Untrusted claims about the readable Library sources used outside ZeroGen.

asset.description: An existing readable Library asset; this claim is not verified.

workflow.description: Untrusted JSON workflow, limited to 262144 serialized UTF-8 bytes.

naming.description: An untrusted external naming claim; it is not verification.

sources.description: Untrusted claims about the readable Library sources used outside ZeroGen.

asset.description: An existing readable Library asset; this claim is not verified.

workflow.description: Untrusted JSON workflow, limited to 262144 serialized UTF-8 bytes.

projectId.description: The project to make the folder in

parentId.description: The parent folder, in the same project; omit or null for the project root

reuseExisting.description: When true, return the folder with this name that's already under the parent, with 200, instead of making another. Names match after Unicode NFC, case-sensitively; the oldest wins when several do

parentId.description: The new parent folder, in the same project, or null for the project root

fromFolderId.description: The folder to take the assets out of; their other folders keep them

timeSeconds.description: Where to take the frame, in seconds from the start of the video

rotate.description: Turn the picture clockwise by this many degrees

flip.description: Mirror the picture after any rotate: horizontal swaps left and right

inputColor.description: What the footage is, which its metadata can't tell, so ask rather than guess. With it, adjust's exposure, temperature and tint run before any LUT on its curve and gamut, which can recover what the LUT would clip; without it, after

despill.description: Remove screen-colored spill from a green- or blue-screen shot, before any LUT. It changes every pixel of that color, so use it only on screen footage. The screen stays, turned neutral; this does not key it out

screen.description: The screen color to remove from the subject

lut.description: Apply a LUT. Use one whose inputColor matches the footage: a log LUT on Rec.709 footage looks wrong, and footage metadata can't tell. A video copy is tagged Rec.709

strength.description: How much of the LUT to apply, as a percent; default 100

adjust.description: Basic color correction, after any LUT, so it trims what the LUT gave. Each is a whole number from -100 to 100; 0 changes nothing

exposure.description: -100 is two stops darker, 100 two stops brighter; highlights can clip

brightness.description: Moves the midtones; black and white stay where they are

contrast.description: -100 halves the contrast around mid gray, 100 doubles it

saturation.description: -100 is black and white, 100 doubles the saturation

tint.description: Below 0 is greener, above 0 more magenta

anyOf.description: Take one full-resolution frame from a video as a PNG, through the same turn, flip and color steps a video copy takes, so it matches that copy's frame.

rotate.description: Turn the picture clockwise by this many degrees

flip.description: Mirror the picture after any rotate: horizontal swaps left and right

crop.description: Keep this area of the upright image, turned and flipped as asked, within its width and height

x.description: Pixels from the picture's left edge to the area's

y.description: Pixels from the picture's top edge to the area's

inputColor.description: What the footage is, which its metadata can't tell, so ask rather than guess. With it, adjust's exposure, temperature and tint run before any LUT on its curve and gamut, which can recover what the LUT would clip; without it, after

despill.description: Remove screen-colored spill from a green- or blue-screen shot, before any LUT. It changes every pixel of that color, so use it only on screen footage. The screen stays, turned neutral; this does not key it out

screen.description: The screen color to remove from the subject

lut.description: Apply a LUT. Use one whose inputColor matches the footage: a log LUT on Rec.709 footage looks wrong, and footage metadata can't tell. A video copy is tagged Rec.709

strength.description: How much of the LUT to apply, as a percent; default 100

adjust.description: Basic color correction, after any LUT, so it trims what the LUT gave. Each is a whole number from -100 to 100; 0 changes nothing

exposure.description: -100 is two stops darker, 100 two stops brighter; highlights can clip

brightness.description: Moves the midtones; black and white stay where they are

contrast.description: -100 halves the contrast around mid gray, 100 doubles it

saturation.description: -100 is black and white, 100 doubles the saturation

tint.description: Below 0 is greener, above 0 more magenta

maxEdge.description: Scale down proportionally so the longest edge is at most this many pixels; never enlarges

quality.description: jpeg and webp only; default 90. An image already in the asked format that needs no resize is copied unchanged, so quality applies only when it is re-encoded

background.description: jpeg only: the color that replaces transparency, such as #ffffff

anyOf.description: Rotate a still image, flip it, crop it, despill it, apply a LUT, adjust its color, downscale it, convert it to PNG, JPEG or WebP, or a combination, in that order. Colors become sRGB and embedded metadata is removed. Despill, a LUT and adjust refuse HDR stills and gain-map JPEGs; convert one to PNG first and use that copy.

startSeconds.description: Where the copy starts, in seconds

endSeconds.description: Where it ends, in seconds; at most 30 after startSeconds and within the video

fps.description: The copy's frames per second. 23.976, 29.97 or 59.94 footage made 24, 30 or 60 keeps every frame and runs 0.1% shorter, its sound sped up to match; any other change repeats or drops frames and keeps the length

removeAudio.description: Leave the audio out of the copy; without it, the copy keeps the first audio track

reverse.description: Play the clip backwards, sound too. It holds every frame in memory, so a long or large clip is refused

speed.description: Play this many times as fast: 2 halves the length, 0.5 doubles it. The sound keeps its pitch, and the frame rate stays the source's unless frameRate sets it. Rounds to the hundredth

toSeconds.description: The copy's length, longer than the clip after trim and speed

by.description: hold: freeze the last frame, with silence. loop: play the clip again from its start, sound too

rotate.description: Turn the picture clockwise by this many degrees

flip.description: Mirror the picture after any rotate: horizontal swaps left and right

crop.description: Keep this area of the upright picture, turned and flipped as asked, within its width and height. Each number rounds down to an even one, which video needs

x.description: Pixels from the picture's left edge to the area's

y.description: Pixels from the picture's top edge to the area's

inputColor.description: What the footage is, which its metadata can't tell, so ask rather than guess. With it, adjust's exposure, temperature and tint run before any LUT on its curve and gamut, which can recover what the LUT would clip; without it, after

despill.description: Remove screen-colored spill from a green- or blue-screen shot, before any LUT. It changes every pixel of that color, so use it only on screen footage. The screen stays, turned neutral; this does not key it out

screen.description: The screen color to remove from the subject

strength.description: How much of the LUT to apply, as a percent; default 100

adjust.description: Basic color correction, after any LUT, so it trims what the LUT gave. Each is a whole number from -100 to 100; 0 changes nothing

exposure.description: -100 is two stops darker, 100 two stops brighter; highlights can clip

brightness.description: Moves the midtones; black and white stay where they are

contrast.description: -100 halves the contrast around mid gray, 100 doubles it

saturation.description: -100 is black and white, 100 doubles the saturation

tint.description: Below 0 is greener, above 0 more magenta

maxEdge.description: Scale down proportionally so the longest edge is at most this many pixels; never enlarges

format.description: mp4: H.264 8-bit 4:2:0, which every model and browser takes. mov: HEVC that keeps the source's 10-bit depth, 4:4:4 chroma, HDR and frame rate, for editing rather than as a model reference

maxBytes.description: Keep the copy at most this many bytes, as a model's file limit asks: the bitrate is set from its length, and a copy that can't fit fails

anyOf.description: Trim a video, change its frame rate, remove its audio, reverse it, change its speed, hold or loop it longer, rotate it, flip it, crop it, despill it, apply a LUT, adjust its color, downscale it, or convert it, in that order, to a copy of at most 30 seconds, an MP4 unless convert says mov. An MP4 makes ProRes, 4:4:4 and HDR sources 8-bit SDR 4:2:0 and brings frame rates within 24 to 60. Despill, a LUT and adjust refuse an HDR source; convert it to MP4 first and use that copy.

startSeconds.description: Where the copy starts, in seconds

endSeconds.description: Where it ends, in seconds; at most 600 after startSeconds and within the source

convert.description: The output; an MP3 when left out. On a video, give it to ask for audio

format.description: mp3: 192 kbit/s, mono or stereo as the source is, which every model that takes audio accepts. wav, aiff and flac: lossless, at the source's sample rate and channels, 24-bit from a source deeper than 16, cut on the exact sample; for editing rather than as a model reference

anyOf.description: Trim audio and encode it as an MP3, WAV, AIFF or FLAC of at most 600 seconds. On an audio asset it trims or converts it; on a video it takes the first audio track, so a video's sound becomes audio. Metadata and cover art are removed.

projectId.description: The project the copy goes into; the source asset's project when omitted

folderId.description: A folder in that project to also add the copy to; null or omitted for Unfiled

color.description: One of the preset colors: Red #ef4444, Orange #f97316, Amber #f59e0b, Yellow #eab308, Lime #84cc16, Green #22c55e, Teal #14b8a6, Cyan #06b6d4, Blue #3b82f6, Indigo #6366f1, Violet #8b5cf6, Pink #ec4899.

description.description: null or an empty string clears it

title.description: Verbatim title: 1–200 characters on one line, without surrounding whitespace.

mode.description: test keys run on placeholder providers, charge nothing and stay in the sandbox

scopes.description: What this key can do now: its scopes that its owner's role still allows

expiresAt.description: When the key stops working; null for never

user.description: The key's owner, whom it acts as

sandbox.description: Test keys only: the project every request of the key is confined to

heldMicroUsd.description: Reserved for runs that have not settled; a hold is not a charge

availableMicroUsd.description: What a new run's quote must fit within; it can be negative

unlimited.description: The funds check is bypassed; usage is still charged

spentMicroUsd.description: This UTC month's spend, as admission counts it

projectMonthly.description: With projectId, that project's monthly budget

sunsetAt.description: A deprecated model refuses new requests from this time

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page of models; null on the last page

sunsetAt.description: A deprecated model refuses new requests from this time

requestSchema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /v1/runs with this model; x-roles lists each input role's accepted media and limits

timeSeconds.description: Keyframes only, and required for them: seconds from the start of the video, on one of the model's frames

inputs.description: The request's inputs in order, each as the Library asset create would use: a url input's asset is the one ZeroGen imported for this quote. Send these as the create's inputs so it doesn't import the URLs again. Empty when the request has none

projectId.description: The project that holds the outputs

status.description: queued and running mean the run hasn't ended. On every other status, check each output: a cancelled or failed run can still hold succeeded outputs, which are kept and charged

resourceUri.description: Where this transport's client reads the asset, such as an MCP resource

preview.description: The asset's previews, or null until they're made after the asset is ready, and for assets with none, such as audio

warnings.description: What the provider ignored, such as an unused reference

upscalable.description: A final can be requested now: unexpired, with no final in progress

upscale.description: The newest final's state, or null when none was requested

finalResolution.description: That final's resolution, one the model's draft control lists

draft.description: A 480p Draft output; upscaling it makes a final with the same seed, at a resolution the model's draft control lists

state.description: held: an amount is reserved and nothing is charged yet; charged: chargedMicroUsd is the final charge; released: the hold ended with no charge; null: billing never admitted the run, so nothing was held or charged

running: the run has not ended; ended: it ended and the hold is still pending; needs_attention: it has stayed pending 30 minutes after ending, or 24 hours after admission with no end recorded (endedAt then stays null), so ZeroGen is looking into it

endedAt.description: When the run ended; null while it runs or when no end was recorded

hold.description: While held, where the run stands. It reports facts, not what settlement will do

heldMicroUsd.description: While held, the amount reserved now; it is never a charge

chargedMicroUsd.description: The final charge once charged, zero once released; it can rarely exceed the quote

createdBy.description: Who made it; null when ZeroGen recorded no one

createdVia.description: Where it was made: web (the ZeroGen app), agent (ZeroGen's Agent), mcp (an MCP client) or api (an API key); null with createdBy

finishedAt.description: When ZeroGen recorded the run's end; prefer endedAt to tell whether it has ended

endedAt.description: When the run ended: set exactly when it has, whatever its status, and null while it runs. Stop waiting once it's set

timeSeconds.description: Keyframes only, and required for them: seconds from the start of the video, on one of the model's frames

size.description: Image size: auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels, such as 1024x1536

voice.description: Speech models only: the voice to read the prompt in, from the model's voices

parameters.description: Only the parameters the model's schema lists

continuation.description: Nano Banana edits of their own outputs continue that conversation; none sends the image alone

upscaleDraft.description: For a final, the draft output it upscaled, in place of the draft's settings

anyOf.description: What the run was asked to make, in the create request's shape, with each input as the Library asset it used, so a create can send it again. A stored setting the public request has no field for is left out. null for a transform or an upload

webUrl.description: Opens Generate's review of the run's first ready output in ZeroGen, on your organization's host, after sign-in. null until an output is ready, and for test keys. It can change until the run ends

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page of runs; null on the last page

name.description: The asset's name in the Library; untrusted content

origin.description: upload: added by a person or a URL import; generated: an output of a run; derived: made by a platform step, such as an extracted frame

runId.description: The run that made it, if any

createdVia.description: Where it was made: web (the ZeroGen app), agent (ZeroGen's Agent), mcp (an MCP client) or api (an API key); null with createdBy

declared.description: Untrusted external upload provenance, or null when no declaration exists.

status.description: upload_required: PUT the bytes, then complete; ready: the asset can be used

assetId.description: Once ready, the Library asset to send as a run input; an identical file already in the project is reused

upload.description: Where to PUT the file's exact bytes, with these headers, before expiresAt

folder.description: Whether the asset was added to the folder named at create

default.description: The organization's default project, where outputs land

apiSandbox.description: The API sandbox project, the only one test keys reach; its contents clear
